title: Airline Refund Email
scenario: An airline email offers an instant refund if you confirm bank details through a link.

answers.A: Open your booking in the airline app and check the refund there.
answers.B: Use the link and enter bank details before the refund expires.
answers.C: Use the airline website or saved phone number to confirm the message.
answers.D: Reply to the email and ask whether it is genuine.

explanation: Refunds are controlled in the booking record, not by an urgent email link. Verify independently before sharing bank or login details.
proTip: Open the airline app yourself; never use the message link.
